title: Pure Yummy
summary: Yummy cards with the generic Beast and Synchro pieces from the page's combo lines, plus generic staples. The page's other lines add Sky Striker and Mitsurugi cards and the now-Forbidden Herald of the Arc Light, so they use cards this list leaves out. A Level 1 Yummy becomes Yummy★Snatchy, which places a Yummy Field Spell and Synchro Summons on either player's turn. Snatchy counts as a Level 1 Tuner for the Yummy Way Synchros, and every Way returns to the Extra Deck on the opponent's turn to bring back two Yummy monsters. Assist★Yummy!, the newest card, bounces a card from the field or either GY and loops Yummy cards from the Deck. Cupsy, Cupsy Way and Snatchy are Limited.

exclude.Herald of the Arc Light: Forbidden in the TCG; the page's older lines still use it.

main: Cooky☆Yummy
Summons itself next to a Link-1 or Level 2 Synchro; summoned, shrinks a monster, or destroys it when a Synchro summoned it.
Lollipo☆Yummy
Summons itself the same way; summoned, shuffles or banishes a card from their GY.
Marshmao☆Yummy
Summons itself with no monsters or only LIGHT Beasts; returns a Yummy Spell/Trap or places a Yummy Field Spell.
Cupsy☆Yummy
Limited. Summons itself the same way; summoned, searches a Yummy card or draws.
Obedience Schooled
Generic Beast Spell from the page's lines: summons three different Level 1 Yummy monsters from the Deck.
Yummyusment☆Mignon
Field Spell: pumps your Yummy monsters and revives a Level 1 Yummy next to a Link-1.
Yummyusment★Acroquey
Field Spell: destroys a card when you Synchro Summon a LIGHT Beast, and summons a Yummy when theirs removes yours.
Yummy☆Surprise
Quick-Play: bounces two of theirs with two of yours, revives a Yummy, or swaps the Field Spell.
Yum☆Yum☆Yummys
Sends Snatchy and another monster to summon a Yummy Synchro; Link Summons Snatchy on their turn.
Assist★Yummy!
Newest support. Sends two Yummy cards to bounce a card from the field or either GY; from the GY, mills a Yummy card.
Yummy★Redemption
Shrinks their monsters, draws on a LIGHT Beast Synchro, and swaps control from the GY.
extra: Limited. Link-1: places a Yummy Field Spell and Synchro Summons on either player's turn.
Limited. Level 2 Synchro: searches two Yummy monsters; tags out for two from the GY.
Level 2 Synchro: flips two monsters face-down; tags out for two Yummy from the GY.
Level 2 Synchro: revives two Yummy; tags out for two more.
Generic Level 3 Synchro Tuner from the page's lines: revives a Tuner.
Generic Level 3 Synchro Tuner from the page's lines: Synchro Summons again on their Main Phase.
